hero.name: Md. Ayubur Rahaman
hero.statement: I build scalable full-stack web and mobile applications with Next.js and Node.js - from backend APIs and database design to cross-platform apps with React Native.

about.label: // about
paragraphs: I'm a software engineer based in Dhaka, currently working as a Software Engineer II at ShellBeeHaken Ltd. Most of my work sits across the full stack — Next.js and Node.js on the web, React Native on mobile, and PostgreSQL or MongoDB underneath.

I gravitate toward problems that touch the whole system: designing an API, tuning the queries behind it, and making sure the real-time or event-driven pieces (Lambda, WebSockets, Redis) hold up under load.
I care about reusable architecture and code that's easy for the next engineer to pick up — a habit built over several years moving between backend, frontend, and mobile on the same projects.

items.name: FAM Sports Nutrition Learning Platform
items.description: An interactive learning platform training professional sports nutrition advisors through structured courses and one-on-one consultations, across web and mobile.
outcomes: Built the admin and customer-facing web apps with Next.js and Node.js, plus a cross-platform mobile app with React Native for iOS and Android.
Shipped an AI-powered chat feature and a consultation module connecting users with professional nutritionists.
Implemented multiple Stripe payment and subscription flows for platform access.

items.name: KriyaKarak
items.description: A secure platform unifying service providers from across Bangladesh onto a single digital marketplace.
outcomes: Owned the Expert Portfolio Module end-to-end — frontend architecture, UI, and feature integration.
Improved service scheduling and booking workflows in the Booking Module.

impact: Built scalable full-stack applications with Next.js, Node.js, MongoDB, and PostgreSQL, including complex aggregation pipelines and query optimization.
Designed event-driven workflows using AWS Lambda, WebSockets, and Redis for real-time features and background processing.
Developed cross-platform mobile apps with React Native and containerized services with Docker for consistent deployments.
Designed and built the UI for the organization's ERP system in Angular, and its e-commerce platform in React.js and Next.js.
Built a cross-platform mobile application with React Native.
Developed backend services in PHP with optimized PostgreSQL databases and queries.
